decisions.reason: A hearty bread on existing lines is cheap to keep, and the lack of website evidence since 2019 is no clear negative signal, so the option stays open.
The sweet pastry fits the core range and costs little to sustain, and the unresolved uncertainty without a negative result does not justify abandoning it.
Crusty farmhouse bread is close to the core business and uses existing production, so keeping the option open costs little while its value is still unclear.
The gold-awarded poppy seed stollen is a flagship with positive resolved evidence, which justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The premium stollen won a gold award and is a seasonal specialty with low carrying cost, so its demonstrated value warrants keeping it.
